proof_roadmap.step: Koszul-complex resolution verifies pseudo-coherence and bounded tor dimension.

difficulty_reason: The lemma states both that a regular immersion of schemes is perfect and that a Koszul-regular immersion is perfect. The retained proof is written: regular immersions are Koszul-regular (Divisors, lemma regular-quasi-regular-immersion), so it suffices to treat the Koszul case; translated to algebra, for I = (f_1,...,f_r) a Koszul-regular sequence in A, the surjection A -> A/I presents A/I as a quotient of the polynomial algebra, so perfectness of the ring map reduces (by the definition: pseudo-coherent plus finite tor dimension over the presentation) to A/I being a perfect A-module; the Koszul complex K(A, f_1,...,f_r) is by definition of Koszul-regularity a finite free resolution of A/I, which simultaneously gives pseudo-coherence and finite tor dimension. Retained author proof at lines 17819-17831.
